about: Fixtures for #43 (Publish To client). Pure cases: no disk, no network. Names, folders and people are fictional. Spec: docs/handoff/design-43-to-client.md. The expected values for safe_name and file-name cases were produced by src/clark/platform.py as on main; the clash, folder-check and request cases are the spec's rulings.

contract.client_file_name: client_file_name(code, week_ending, today, folder) -> str  # = publish.file_name (#39); folder_chars is the length of the folder path, made up of x's for the test
contract.resolve_clash: resolve_clash(name, existing, choice=None, new_name=None) -> {action: write|ask|nothing_to_do|cancel|refuse, ...}; existing = [{name, kind: file|folder, same_content?}] (the names in the client folder, same_content only for the entry with the same name); matching ignores letter case
contract.check_client_folder: check_client_folder(path, *, data_dir, onedrive_roots, local_folder, exists, is_dir, writable) -> {ok, folder, warning} | {ok: false, message}; pure: the facts about the disk come in as arguments
contract.request: validate_request(body, saved_client_folder) -> {to_client} | error {status, message}; allowed keys: project, to_client, on_clash, new_name

messages.clash_title: A file with that name is already in the client folder
messages.overwrite_note: The client's copy is replaced. clark keeps no backup in the client folder, because OneDrive would upload it.
messages.done_new: Published. Saved locally, and copied to the client folder as “{name}”. OneDrive uploads it from there; clark can't see when that finishes.
messages.done_numbered: Published. Saved locally, and copied to the client folder as “{name}” because “{asked}” was already there. OneDrive uploads it from there; clark can't see when that finishes.
messages.done_replaced: Published. Saved locally, and “{name}” in the client folder was replaced. OneDrive uploads it from there; clark can't see when that finishes.
messages.done_same: Published locally. The client folder already has this exact file (“{name}”), so nothing was copied.
messages.folder_missing_nothing_written: The client folder “{folder_name}” isn't there. Check that OneDrive is running and the folder is still synced, or choose another folder in Settings. Nothing was published.
messages.copy_failed_local_kept: Saved locally, but not copied to the client folder: {reason} Nothing was added to the client folder.
messages.copy_differs: Saved locally, but the copy in the client folder did not match the published file, so clark removed it. Try again.
messages.copy_differs_after_overwrite: Saved locally, but the copy that replaced “{name}” in the client folder did not match the published file. Publish again to put it right.

file_name_cases.why: platform.safe_name alone cuts the date off the end (PUB-report-20.html), so two weeks would get one name. #43 keeps the date and .html and shortens the code part: first 'PUB-report' goes, then the code.
Less than two letters of the code would fit with the date, so the folder is refused instead of making an unreadable name.
